summary: The proposed patch addresses the specific issue of handling empty lines in text labels for the PostScript backend, but there are some concerns regarding test coverage and potential edge cases.

issues.description: While the patch fixes the immediate issue, there are no additional tests added to cover the case where multiple consecutive empty lines might occur or how the backend handles other special characters or formatting within text labels.
The patch does not address whether the same issue exists in other parts of the backend or if similar logic needs to be applied elsewhere to handle empty lines consistently.
